Polyphase: do the work at the low rate

Set taps and a decimation factor. The taps are dealt into R short filters that each run at the output rate, and the work per output drops by R.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • gHashTag/t27 specs/fpga/dsp/signals.t27 (t27#8985): every value on the page is its fn bodies, compiled to wasm (logic.js)
  • R. E. Crochiere, L. R. Rabiner, Multirate Digital Signal Processing, Prentice Hall, 1983: decimation and polyphase structures
